meta.name: Tectonic Rivet Tinker Head
meta.description: The Enclave First Forge & Stormbreaker Concordance pioneered this modular tool component. By binding a Tectonic Crucible with the resilient Rivet Chisel Tap Guard, they crafted a part that sheds subterranean slag. When submerged in deep quarry fluids, its hyper-dense alloy naturally repels detritus, easing the burden of grime for meticulous miners.
